places.name: Jungle coast
places.note: I reached a wooded coast by exploring; check claims before settling.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Birch workbench
places.note: Temporary crafting table placed in the birch woods.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Birch grass search
places.note: Open forest edge where I searched tall grass for wheat seeds.
places.author: Margo

places.name: My first wheat seed
places.note: Seeded an empty dark farmland square in the extra stream row Gary and spesk said we could use.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Margo stream-bank crafting table 2
places.note: New crafting table on coarse dirt clearing among birches, west of wheat plot.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Margo podzol crafting table
places.note: Working table placed on dry podzol outside the stream garden; verified CraftingScreen opens.
places.author: Margo

places.name: West-coast overlook
places.note: Birch ridge above open ocean. Direct water path led into a deep stone ravine; approach shore another way.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North-coast worktable
places.note: My table on a grassy patch; use confirmed the CraftingScreen.
places.author: Margo

places.name: West exposed stone shelf
places.note: Dry open rock shelf with visible ore flecks; inspect blocks carefully from the top, no route through others' builds.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Margo meadow worktable
places.note: Crafting table placed on open meadow grass north-east of Gary's cabin; used successfully to craft a wooden hoe.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Margo west bank wheat
places.note: Three wheat tiles on my open west-bank plot near water; uneven ground needs more scouting.
places.author: Margo

places.name: West bank clay layer
places.note: Find-block detected a broad clay deposit well below the stream. No verified entrance yet.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South slope sand patch
places.note: Sand exposed beside a lit trail, with at least 16 sand blocks in the slope. Surface includes stone steps and a torch, so find an undisturbed edge or another deposit for harvesting.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South slope coal seam
places.note: Several coal blocks below the southern slope, located by block scan. Surface route to the ore remains untested.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North ridge coal seam
places.note: Mined four coal here and left a torch. Coal and other ores remain exposed in a shallow cut. Surface approach from the south works.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North ridge iron seam
places.note: Mined three raw iron from a small cut without injury. Exposed iron remains. Approach the lip from the open ridge south of the seam.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Margo stream wheat
places.note: This tile regrew to mature between two harvests. Empty-hand use replanted it both times. Approach the planted rows from the cobblestone walkway.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Blank sign beside shared furnace
places.note: Accidentally placed my blank sign while opening the nearby furnace. Told Gary. It is off the furnace approach; remove the sign itself or label it if Gary agrees.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Jungle bridge reported by spesk01
places.note: spesk01 reports this bridge beside their base crosses a small sea into a jungle biome. Follow the public route and give the base a wide berth.
places.author: Margo

places.name: spesk01 offered redstone chest
places.note: Corrected to the elevated double chest left of the stairs. spesk01 offered one stack, which I took. Return up the existing stair lane.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South ravine copper and osmium approach
places.note: Natural slope near shallow osmium and copper. Survey point; no verified mine entrance yet.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South ravine shallow ore torch
places.note: First torch inside dry osmium cut. Return uphill toward the separate South ravine copper and osmium approach.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southeast shore deep mine portal
places.note: New exploratory gold stair on unbuilt shore slope. Approached via the east birch slope. Work in progress.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southeast gold stair first bend
places.note: Lit landing. From portal, follow the east stair down here; next section turns north.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southeast gold stair second bend
places.note: From first bend turn north. From this landing the next stair heads west below the shore.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind perch candidate
places.note: Open sky checked beside the workshop. Plan for a south-facing output and cable down immediately north of the Infuser.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South ravine sand pockets
places.note: Five sand gathered beside the grass ledge. Return via the open slope east and the ravine upper trail. Sand under the powered rail is part of the line and should stay.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore portal Nether frame
places.note: Verified arrival in the Nether. Portal sits in a crimson canopy below a low rock ceiling. Remain on the frame until a dry landing is marked.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Existing return portal by jungle rail
places.note: Shore portal arrives at canopy frame, but that frame routes here. This portal is in a claimed room. Get steward's permission before using it as a supply route.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Jungle east outside path
places.note: Natural grass exit above the wheat terraces. From portal's southwest step, take the paved lane north and turn east at its end. Walk around the terraces.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore diamond seam
places.note: Lit pocket at the end of the east-then-south stair. Cobble step leads back to the main climb. More ore remains below the mined pocket.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Crimson-warped route saddle
places.note: Upper canopy turn for the warped terrace descent. Return by the cobble steps through natural wart.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Lower stream coop shelf
places.note: Building a roofed coop on the dry shelf south of the stream. The entry faces north toward the wheat.
places.author: Margo

places.name: West pig pen safe apron
places.note: Outside west gate, facing east. Walk to apron from south of the workbench. Open each gate manually before entering its crossing. Stay off path goals on fence or gate blocks.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Meadow kelp basin lower stand
places.note: South side of dugout below the meadow bunkhouse. East end is the deep planting well; centre is the refill cell.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Stream refill standing point
places.note: Dry north-side field rim. From here aim into the broad trough one block west and two blocks south. The replenishing water cell at the north end supplied both buckets.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Far east dry sand notch
places.note: Dry grass meets exposed sand on the southeast point. Seven surface blocks from the small shore notch came out without flooding. Approach from the north grass shelf.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Birch west descent entrance
places.note: West-facing stepped entrance in the birch clearing. Follow torches down and return east on the same steps.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southwest birch cliff sea foot
places.note: Water at the foot of the tall bare rock drop. The last inland ridge waypoint is high. Take the open-water skirt toward jungle, or choose a gentler ramp to return.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Offshore timber marker
places.note: Sparse long wooden strips protrude above deep water between the birch cliffs and jungle shore. Ownership unknown. Swim past without altering it.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South jungle volcanic overlook
places.note: High jungle edge above dark ridges and visible lava fields. Observe from the grassy north shoulder and avoid the steep south face.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Birch descent south branch junction
places.note: At the lower torch turn south for the planned lapis approach. The short north branch holds Immersive Engineering bauxite. Return up the stone stairs to the east.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North birch ridge return saddle
places.note: Safe high line left of the zombie hollow and iron cut. Return southeast along birches to the workshop side of Gary's cabin.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Northwest birch coast high bend
places.note: Two cows on approach below the rain-dark birches. To return to high ridge, turn east up the grassy contour before the exposed shore.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Bunkhouse southeast meadow turn
places.note: Grass shelf outside the bunkhouse, east of the kelp basin. Follow the outer birches south to the nursery step.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind bread test bench
places.note: Private test waypoint. Wheat feed hopper proven. Encode Formula and Auto-Mode body controls still needed.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind LV branch survey
places.note: Existing west wind riser has charge. Candidate above the front grass aisle is an accumulator east of the high riser with a high cable run to a lantern on the workshop approach.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind metal press shelf
places.note: Open podzol shelf immediately east of the rear bread test. Keep the south aisle and east grass approach clear. Future press feed west, pickup east.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Northwest dark oak return saddle
places.note: Natural crest above the low translucent river. There were skeletons by the shaded western stone cut. Use nearby grass to leave by daylight.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South meadow osmium face
places.note: Lit working end of the northward stair, with two ore blocks in the east wall.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore west grass halfway
places.note: Gary led through this grass turn between the west terrace bypass and dry ravine climb. Follow the rising shelf, keeping outside the terraces.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North ridge deep iron branch landing
places.note: New torchlit stairs continue north from here. Six dense iron blocks extracted in the lower pocket. Older west branch stays open.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind Assembler east service step
places.note: From the press east feed shelf, stay on the natural slope then step onto this cobble tread. Pickup shelf is one block higher and west.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind Assembler pickup shelf
places.note: Torch and cobble pad two blocks east of the frame centre, reached from the marked east service step.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind Assembler west controls
places.note: Approach uphill from Workshop rear aisle via the high grass west of the frame. Main item input is the west-facing lower slot.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Meadow bunkhouse door step
places.note: Come from the southeast meadow turn to the south cobble step. Open the birch door and close it behind you.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North ridge coal cut iron alcove
places.note: Four dense ore blocks gave ten raw iron in the shallow coal cut west wall. Original zinc in the north wall and rhodochrosite above were left. Exit via torch and upper coal approach.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North ridge refilled iron test
places.note: Small dense iron trench beside the hollow was filled back flush. One visible osmium stayed buried beneath the plug. The birch sapling marks the restored slope.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Granite sea notch upper foothold
places.note: Reached on foot with Gary from the stone saddle. Stop on the dry white-stone approach above the lower bench ledge. The coastal slope drops steeply east.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore east grass traverse
places.note: Walked here from the gold stair along grass above the water. Return west via the lower grass saddle, then the gold stair shelf.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East sand ridge return shelf
places.note: Dry point above the East sand notch. To return on foot, head west through Shore east grass traverse. Low damp cut before the traverse is shallow.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southern chalk stair upper turn
places.note: Lit return stair from the lower chalk shelf. The upper tread turns one block inland to the stone shoulder. The outer face drops sharply.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southern chalk cliff stop
places.note: Below the exposed chalk face. At the shelf, follow the narrow lit hand-cut stair west, then turn one tread inland at the top. Avoid the steep descent to its east.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore deep geode scan
places.note: Nearest budding amethyst from the boat porch scan. A survey point only. Seek a dry approach from the existing shoreline deep stair and preserve every budding block.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped quartz low roof
places.note: Two cobblestone ceiling blocks extend the low end of the quartz cut. From the exterior steps, walk into the trench and stay under the roof while recovering.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped terrace low canopy
places.note: Three-by-three cobblestone roof, two blocks of standing height. Approach by the quartz-cut torch route. Test stance is the center under the roof.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South meadow open slope
places.note: An open grass sightline below the rest bench. Walk west of shallow dips back to the North-facing rise and low canopy. Turn back before the southern drop.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North ridge coal pocket lamp
places.note: Lit pocket off the north edge of the shallow coal room. Fourteen coal collected from walls. Coal floor supports the walk and remains intact.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North birch shallow iron cut
places.note: Lit narrow surface stair to worked shallow pocket. Approach from birch ridge return saddle. Eight more dense iron blocks scanned farther north; route there untested.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore lower moss shelf
places.note: Dry foothold beside flooded lush cavity. Wrong direction for returning from gold pocket; lower pool loops surface rescue. Cobble escape pillar stands here.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore gold upper clay turn
places.note: Lit turn of original gold stairs. From here, walk-only to the lava branch turn worked. Bank below may send broad goals into the moss cavity.
places.author: Margo

places.name: West saddle potato lookout
places.note: From the meadow, walk-only reaches this grass footing just east of the patch. The crops and torch are visible across the gravel. Use the east bend to reach the porch without crossing farmland.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Meadow waystone foot of stair
places.note: South dirt path at the stone-brick landing. Ascend the centre stair; the kiln lane remains open on the west and north.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped upper ridge torch turn
places.note: Walked up from the enclosed canopy via the west hillside; high forest turning point.
places.author: Margo

places.name: South meadow low canopy
places.note: Five-by-five cobblestone roof. Enter from the open slope west of the pillar. The downhill edge has an extra block of clearance.
places.author: Margo

refuge.access: Walk in from South meadow open slope. Stay on the raised grass under the centre.
refuge.hazards: Open sides and a taller downhill edge. Combat trial still pending. Watch the slope farther south.

places.name: Crimson covered barter berth
places.note: Lit cut to the east of the red refuge, with two-wide level footing below solid stone and a birch berth. Open entrance to the south.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Fleet west cove jobless villager
places.note: Former pickup area. The unemployed adult from here is at Fleet coast cleric boat landing.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Meadow bunkhouse west chest
places.note: Under west window. A 54-slot Iron Chest for equipment and material reserves. The east birch chests hold the waystone stock.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore gold dry lower tread
places.note: Lit floor beside two-block cobble cap over the flooded moss pocket. Follow the short north cobble steps back to the shallow side landing. Leave the cap closed.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southeast gold shallow side landing
places.note: Lit landing. Inner working face drops via two short dry cobble steps and a natural tread. Lower eastern water opening is plugged. Use the upper clay turn to leave.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Southeast gold exit stair foot
places.note: Lith path heads to upper clay turn. One cobble was added below this on the last exit; verify short treads from the shallow landing.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped ridge north overlook
places.note: Lit upper turn against netherrack wall. Steps south lead to the ridge low roof. Open drop toward the west forest bowl; inspect short legs.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped ridge west shelf turn
places.note: Torch on the high corner south of the natural netherrack wall. Look south-east to return by the north overlook.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped bowl lower shroomlight turn
places.note: One low stone tile and a torch near the shroomlight stem. Access from the ridge west turn. Short descent to the open west forest; no lava found within sixteen blocks.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped bowl low cover
places.note: Lit two-wide cobble roof at foot of west slope. Walk through the southwest side at current level. North and west rise sharply, keep view low. Entered from shroomlight turn.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Meadow northeast iron stair upper lip
places.note: Natural birch slope opening above the dense iron pocket. Entrance and route verified from below. Descend north in short steps under the dirt lip.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Meadow northeast iron stair lower pocket
places.note: Spent eight-block pocket below the lit stair. Walking both ways succeeded. Follow the three treads to the middle torch then south to the upper lip.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Warped quartz low west work floor
places.note: I took 24 quartz from the west wall and low pockets. Return via the remaining ore step south of the northern notch and the higher cobble. Keep those two treads.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind compost bay upper stance
places.note: Dry grass a step above the south shelf. Proposed compost stack below the overhead RS cable. Keep this grass approach clear.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore coal and second redstone spur
places.note: East of the original shore redstone branch. At the coal turn go south two, then east two and down the lower stair. Look at loose ore before mining. Walk back on that same stair.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East meadow shallow iron stair upper lip
places.note: Torch by the open cut east of the walking path. Five east-facing rising treads return to natural grass. The spent lower iron pocket is lit.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East birch dungeon survey slope
places.note: Natural lower birch bench. One cave spawner and Lootr chest were detected far below and northeast. Surface walk back up to East birch low cover.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East birch dungeon survey entrance
places.note: Dry north lip above the short south-facing stone cut. The earth tread gives a walk out. Torch marks the floor where the deeper survey starts.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East birch survey upper cave
places.note: Lit southern cave wall at the first crossing. Return through the narrow opening beside the wall torch. Skeletons were in the dark branch.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East birch survey middle cave
places.note: Natural ledge. A skeleton followed through the upper opening and dropped arrows here. The direct excavating route wandered west through the cavern.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East birch zombie slit drop
places.note: Baby zombie came through the one-block gap above the cobble wall sill. Choke point below the lit stairs. Bring a spare sword and blocks before opening it again.
places.author: Margo

places.name: East birch dungeon half-height slit
places.note: Zombie cage south beyond half-height opening. Floor dip filled. Upper stair is lit but lower approach currently needs excavate driving.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Wind Simulation Chamber standing shelf
places.note: Follow Wind Assembler east service step and look overhead from the dry shelf. The chamber is connected to the green network and charging. Model still pending.
places.author: Margo

places.name: North mixed woods kit drop
places.note: I fell to mobs at night on the low coastal shelf. Use the inland ridge and recover in daylight if you approach.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Fleet north birch bank
places.note: The original fisherman wandered this bank with three hearts. Dry grass and stone approach from Fleet Landing.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Fleet waystone dry shoulder candidate
places.note: Walked to this raised dry grass shelf from the trade apron. It overlooks the signed route and sits clear of the workroom porch, shelter and boat berth.
places.author: Margo

places.name: Shore diamond stair west iron pocket
places.author: Margo
places.note: Short lit western pocket off the south leg of the diamond stair. Exposed iron floor and walls. Use the original floor to return east.
